units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 2:9">Targ. Gen. II, 9</cite>.—Targ. II, <cite ref="Esther 1:19">Esth. I, 19</cite> <he>דטבא</he> ed. Lag. (oth. ed. <he>דטָבַת</he>)—
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Judges 5:26">Targ. Jud. V, 26</cite> (missing in ed. Lag.); a. v. fr.—
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 22:8">Gen. R. s. 22</cite>; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 22:4">Lev. R. s. 22</cite>, v. <cite ref="B00740"><he>בִּישׁ</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 60b:12">Ber. 60ᵇ</cite> <he>כל מאי דעביד … לטב</he> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) whatever God does is for a good purpose.
<cite ref="Tamid 32a:51">Tam. 32ᵃ</cite> <he>דידי טבא וכ׳</he> my advice is better than yours.—
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 33:1">Lev. R. s. 33</cite>, beg. <he>מינה ט׳ וכ׳</he> from it (the tongue) comes what is good &c.; a. v. fr.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 4:13:2">Y. Keth. IV, end, 29ᵇ</cite> <he>חד בית בטב וכ׳</he> (ed. Krot. <he>בדב</he>, read: <he>חד ביתא טב</he>) a house worth &c.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 4:13:2">Ib.</cite> <he>מכיון דלית ביתא טב וכ׳</he> as the house is not worth more than &c.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 1:1:36">Y. Peah I, 15ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>מילא דט׳ דכוותה</he> something of equal value; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 35:3">Gen. R. s. 35</cite>, end (corr. acc.); a. fr.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 4:5:9">Y. Taan. IV, 68ᵈ</cite> top <he>טב קרתא</he> an officer of the town.—Pl. <he>טָבִין</he>, <he>טָבַיָּיא</he>, <cite ref="I00048"><he>טָבֵי</he></cite>; fem. <he>טָבָתָא</he>, <he>טָבָאתָא</he>, <he>טָבָן</he>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Micah 7:1">Targ. Mic. VII, 1</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 125:4">Targ. Ps. CXXV, 4</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 44b:5">B. Mets. 44ᵇ</cite> <he>שלים לה ט׳ וכ׳</he> pay her in good and full-weight coin.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 10:2:5">Y. Snh. X, 28ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>כל טָבָן וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="N00512"><he>נֶחֶמְתָּא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:1">Lam. R. to I, 1</cite> <cite ref="T00152"><he>רבתי</he></cite> (<he>חד מאת׳</he> 1) <he>טבאתא</he> the good fruits; a. fr.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 17:10">Targ. Prov. XVII, 10</cite>.—
Gitt. 14ᵇ טב טב רמו ליה Ar. (ed. only one טב) strike him more (or, it is right, v. Rashi a. l.)—Y. Shek. IV, 48ᵃ top, v. טָבָאוּת.
